HERO.TITLE: The Quiet Luxury of Time
HERO.SUBTITLE: A minimalist, aesthetic canvas for your screen. Suspended in space, Aura serves as a silent horological companion, enriching your desk setup with dynamic liquid glass, gold, and obsidian atmospheres.
HERO.SEO_KEYWORDS: Aesthetic Screen Clock • Minimalist Desk Clock • Glassmorphism Focus Tool • Premium Pomodoro Background

FEATURES.TITLE: Form & Silence
FEATURES.SUBTITLE: Designed not to scream for attention, but to complete the room. Aura is a digital sculpture tailored for modern curation.
FEATURES.CARD_THEMES_DESC: Immerse your space in emerald cashmeres, gold glimmers, and liquid glass. Transitions are butter-smooth and light on resources.
FEATURES.CARD_FLEX_DESC: Configure your dial. Position the time in any corner, tilt it up to 45 degrees, select bespoke typography, and alter scales.
FEATURES.CARD_FOCUS_DESC: Engage a silent Pomodoro focus cycle or drift into synthesized soundscapes—luxury clockwork ticks and rain patterns.
FEATURES.CARD_SEO_DESC: No database overhead. Your preferences are preserved locally and instantly. Fast load speeds ensure an unblemished experience.

THEMES_SHOWCASE.TITLE: The Curated Collections
THEMES_SHOWCASE.SUBTITLE: Selected horological aesthetics evoking the texture of marble, precious metals, and hand-blown glass.
THEMES_SHOWCASE.LIQUID_GLASS_DESC: Amorphous fluid contours flowing behind heavy frosted glass layers.
THEMES_SHOWCASE.EMERALD_GOLD_DESC: Deep imperial emerald textures detailed with polished gold strokes.
THEMES_SHOWCASE.OBSIDIAN_PLATINUM_DESC: Deep piano black surfaces beneath cold, mirror-polished platinum light.
THEMES_SHOWCASE.FROSTED_GLASS_DESC: Warm ivory tones under a refined champagne gold light.

CTA.TITLE: Redefine Your Screen Aura
CTA.SUBTITLE: A clean, quiet, and beautiful ticking companion for your workspace. No advertisements, no clutter.

DESK.TITLE: Your clock, on a screen of its own
DESK.SUBTITLE: AuraTime Desk Display turns a small USB screen next to your keyboard into a live dashboard: time, focus session, tasks, alarms, world clocks and weather.
DESK.P1: Follows your AuraTime theme and font
DESK.P2: Runs in Chrome or Edge: no drivers, no extra software
DESK.P3: Sends only what changes, so it stays smooth
DESK.P4: Night dimming and anti burn-in built in
DESK.MOCK_CAPTION: Live preview with sample data, drawn by the same engine that drives the screen.
DESK.STEPS_TITLE: Set it up in three steps
DESK.S1_D: Use Chrome or Edge on your computer and press the Desk Display button.
DESK.S2_D: Plug in the USB display, press Connect and pick it from the list. It reconnects by itself next time.
DESK.S3_D: Pick what rotates, set the night schedule and let it run all day.
DESK.COMPAT: Compatible with Turing Smart Screen 3.5" (USB) displays.
DESK.DISCLAIMER: AuraTime is an independent project, not affiliated with any display manufacturer. Product names belong to their owners.
DESK.BROWSER_NOTE: Needs Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a computer.

CLOCK.SUPPORT_DESC: Help maintain Aura's server status and future design iterations.

TASKS.SUBTITLE: Priorities aligned with Pomodoro

SEO.DESCRIPTION: Turn a small USB screen into a live AuraTime dashboard: clock, Pomodoro focus, tasks, alarms, world clocks and weather. Runs in Chrome or Edge, no drivers needed.

APP.TITLE: Desk Display
APP.HINT: Show your clock and focus session on a USB screen.

MSG.UNSUPPORTED: This browser has no Web Serial support. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.

PAGE.SUBTITLE: Show your clock, focus session, tasks, alarms and weather on a small USB screen.

PREVIEW.DEMO_NOTE: Sample data. Connect a display to show your own.

S1.TITLE: Check your browser
S1.OK: Great: this browser can talk to USB displays.
S1.TEXT: Desk Display uses Web Serial, available in Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge on a computer.

S2.TITLE: Connect your display
S2.HINT: Plug the display in with its USB cable and close the display's original software first: only one program can use it at a time.
S2.FIRST_TIME: The browser asks you to pick the display once. After that it reconnects by itself.

S3.TITLE: Choose what to show
S3.VIEW_MODE_NOTE: Automatic rotation changes view every 20 seconds; the focus view stays on while a Pomodoro is running.
S3.ROTATION_NOTE: Views with no data (no alarms, no active countdown, no world clocks, no focus this week) are skipped automatically.
S3.FOLLOW_NOTE: By default the display uses the same theme and font as the clock. Pick one to pin it.

ADV.DEMO_TOGGLE: Show sample data while no display is connected
ADV.HINT: If glitches disappear with "full screen", the problem is in the partial updates; if they disappear with "slow send", the display needs more time between chunks.
